name: Jefferson Curl
instructions: Stand on the floor, or on a low step, with the feet together and the knees soft.
Tuck the chin and slowly roll down one vertebra at a time, letting the arms hang.
Continue until you reach a comfortable end range. Stay unloaded until you own the pattern.
Reverse the motion, stacking the spine from the tailbone up to a tall stand.
Move slowly for the set reps. This is a segmental fold, not a sit-up.
